title: Palmer-Bowlus flume width and invert expressions in Figure 3.5
applicability: Annotations printed inside Figure 3.5 (Palmer-Bowlus flume installation in circular sewer) express the flume width W and the small invert dimension t as fractions of the pipe diameter D. The same figure prints D=Conduit diameter and marks D/2 as the preferred head measuring point.
notes: Unnumbered figure expressions; p159-1 is a service locator, not a printed equation number.
Printed as W= 5D/12 and t= D/6 without units; no unit or decimal value has been added.
W and t are printed as the left-hand sides but are not defined anywhere in the annotation block; only D (PIPE DIAMETER) and H (WATER DEPTH) are defined. No definition has been supplied for W or t.
The flume section in the same figure marks 2:1 side slopes and dimension H as the water depth; these are geometry labels, not additional equations.
Source: CPHEEO, 1993 is not printed on this figure; it carries no source line.
